name: Café de Colombia
verdict: The brand of Colombia's non-profit coffee growers' federation; no state in the chain.
note: Official Coffee Partner of Netcompany INEOS, announced 22 April 2026; its logo is on the bib shorts of the 2026 kit. The Federación Nacional de Cafeteros is a private growers' federation of some 540,000 Colombian coffee-growing families.
